expected_result: no finding for local secret storage
scenario: Mobile refresh tokens use platform-backed storage, backup exclusions, redacted logs, and logout revocation.

android.storage: EncryptedSharedPreferences created with MasterKey backed by Android Keystore
android.backup_config: dataExtractionRules exclude shared_prefs/secure_session.xml from cloud-backup and device-transfer
android.logging: network logger redacts Authorization and Set-Cookie headers
android.lifecycle: logout removes secure_session entries and calls revokeDeviceSession

ios.backup_config: refresh token is non-migratable through ThisDeviceOnly Keychain accessibility
ios.runtime_controls: sensitive screens blur app-switcher snapshots and never copy tokens to UIPasteboard
ios.lifecycle: logout deletes the Keychain item and calls revokeDeviceSession

review_notes: The reviewer may still request evidence that Android keys are hardware-backed on supported devices.
The reviewer should classify missing evidence as a follow-up gap, not as plaintext storage.
